policy.purpose: Operational definitions of the physics/neuroscience vocabulary so a metaphor cannot be mistaken for a mechanism. Every ACTIVE mechanism term must carry a mathematical object, an observable->math mapping, units, a validity domain, alternative hypotheses, and a falsifier. Terms with no admissible operational mapping are RETIRED (tombstone) or explicitly labelled ANALOGUE (arithmetic proxy, non-claim).

statuses.mechanism: A rigorous mathematical object with an observable->math mapping and an executable falsifier. Backed by P0/P1 invariants in the registry. This IS a claim.
statuses.analogue: An engineering/arithmetic proxy that borrows a biological or physical name. The name is metaphorical; no biological or physical mechanism is asserted or measured. NON-CLAIM (per INV-HOM1).
statuses.retired: A former term whose framing was a category error or was falsified/withdrawn. Preserved as negative evidence (tombstone). Never backs a live claim.

policy.gate: scripts/ci/check_terminology.py validates every term against schemas/operational_definition.schema.json and fail-closes when: an ACTIVE mechanism term lacks a math_object/observable_mapping/falsifier/alternatives; a metaphor-only term is labelled mechanism; or a term declares an unknown status.
policy.source_of_truth: CLAUDE.md INVARIANT REGISTRY; governance/project_state.yaml (current_state: RESEARCH_ALPHA); FORBIDDEN_CLAIMS.md.

terms.name: synchronization
terms.math_object: Kuramoto order parameter R(t) = |(1/N) * sum_{j=1..N} exp(i*theta_j(t))| in [0,1], complex form z = R*exp(i*psi). Critical coupling K_c = 2/(pi*g(0)); Lorentzian K_c = 2*gamma.
terms.observable_mapping: Per-node phase theta_j(t) is extracted from the analytic signal (Hilbert transform) of each detrended asset log-return series; R is the modulus of the mean phasor. Coupling K is estimated from the empirical coupling graph. z lives on the unit disk.
terms.units: dimensionless (R, z are pure numbers on the unit disk; phases in radians; K, K_c, gamma in inverse-time coupling units)
terms.validity_domain: Finite N ensembles of phase oscillators. Asymptotic laws (INV-K2/K3) hold as t->inf with a finite-size floor <R> ~ O(1/sqrt(N)); use epsilon = 3/sqrt(N), never a magic number. Not a claim about market predictability.
alternatives: Spurious coherence driven by a common exogenous factor (market-wide beta) rather than endogenous oscillator coupling
Finite-size fluctuation: R ~ O(1/sqrt(N)) can masquerade as weak synchrony in small ensembles
Non-stationarity or phase-slip artifacts of the Hilbert phase extraction
A single dominant mode aliased as global synchrony
terms.falsifier: INV-K2: R(t) > 3/sqrt(N) after 1e4 steps at K = 0.1*K_c with N > 100 (a subcritical ensemble must decohere to the finite-size floor). Also INV-K1: any R(t) outside [0,1].

terms.name: curvature
terms.math_object: Ollivier-Ricci curvature kappa(x,y) = 1 - W_1(m_x, m_y)/d(x,y) on a weighted graph, where W_1 is the Wasserstein-1 distance between lazy-random-walk measures m_x, m_y and d is the graph metric.
terms.observable_mapping: Nodes = assets/price levels; edges carry an empirical distance (de)correlation or spread metric; kappa is computed per edge via optimal transport. build_price_graph uses consecutive-integer node IDs so the combinatorial distance matches the 1D positional embedding.
terms.units: dimensionless (kappa is a normalized transport ratio); kappa <= 1 universal
terms.validity_domain: kappa <= 1 for any connected graph (INV-RC1). kappa in [-1,1] ONLY for build_price_graph output (INV-RC3); the 1D positional embedding can drop below -1 for other topologies. Forman-Ricci is a DISTINCT object and is never kappa-bound evidence (category-error guard, INV-CBR1).
alternatives: Metric-embedding artifact: the chosen 1D positional embedding, not market geometry, drives the sign
Sampling noise in the correlation matrix producing spurious negative curvature
Category confusion with Forman-Ricci, which is bounded differently and may exceed 1
terms.falsifier: INV-RC1: kappa > 1 returned for a connected graph. INV-RC3: kappa outside [-1,1] for build_price_graph output. INV-KR4: a signed kappa silently clipped at the Restrepo-Ott-Hunt onset boundary without RicciAdjacencyAudit metadata.

terms.name: energy
terms.math_object: Model energies: Kuramoto coupling potential V = -(K*N/2)*R^2 (all-to-all, omega=0); second-order swing energy E = 0.5*sum(m*thetadot^2) + V; variational free energy F = U - T*S_q (Helmholtz form).
terms.observable_mapping: Computed from the same phase state theta and coupling K as synchronization; free-energy components (U = precision-weighted prediction error, S_q = variational entropy) from the active-inference model state. No physical Joules -- these are chosen Lyapunov functionals of the model state.
terms.units: model-energy units (dimensionless under normalized coupling). F and V may be negative (Helmholtz); components U, T, S_q >= 0
terms.validity_domain: V is non-increasing only with omega_i = 0 (INV-K7); swing energy is conserved (omega=0, d=0) or non-increasing (omega=0, d>=0) (INV-K8/K9); F is non-increasing under active inference (INV-FE1). NOT the thermodynamic energy of the market.
alternatives: Integrator artifact: Euler introduces secular growth that mimics energy injection
The 'energy' is a chosen Lyapunov functional, not a conserved physical quantity -- descent can be true by construction
A damping sign error that injects rather than dissipates
terms.falsifier: INV-K8/K9: swing-energy secular growth (log-log slope collapse 2.01 -> 0.81) under a symplectic integrator, or +d*thetadot producing energy injection. INV-FE1: F(t) increasing under active inference. INV-FE2: any component U, T, S_q < 0.

terms.name: entropy
terms.math_object: Thermodynamic entropy production sigma >= 0 (second law, INV-TH2); variational entropy component S_q >= 0 in F = U - T*S; Shannon/Rayleigh phase entropy for the incoherent-phase test.
terms.observable_mapping: Entropy production from the before/after state of a dissipative update; S_q from the approximate posterior over latent causes; phase entropy from the empirical phase histogram (uniform on [-pi,pi] under INV-K6 in the subcritical regime).
terms.units: nats (Shannon/variational, natural log) or dimensionless model units; entropy production >= 0
terms.validity_domain: Entropy production >= 0 holds for the modeled dissipative dynamics (INV-TH2). The Jarzynski/second-law bounds (INV-ST2/ST3) are pure statistical mechanics on the overdamped Langevin harness, NOT a market model.
alternatives: Estimator bias: finite-sample entropy is biased low, so apparent production may be estimator drift
Binning/discretization artifact in the phase histogram
Non-stationarity mimicking entropy production
terms.falsifier: INV-TH2: measured entropy production < 0. INV-ST2: Jarzynski <exp(-beta*W)> deviates from exp(-beta*dF) beyond tolerance. INV-K6: subcritical phases fail the Rayleigh uniformity test.

terms.name: phase_transition
terms.math_object: Synchronization onset at K_c = 2/(pi*g(0)) (Lorentzian K_c = 2*gamma); order-parameter bifurcation R_inf proportional to sqrt(K - K_c); Restrepo-Ott-Hunt boundary Phi = K*lambda_max(A_kappa) - 2*gamma with sign(Phi) selecting the asymptotic regime; explosive-sync hysteresis width >= 0.
terms.observable_mapping: K_c from the natural-frequency dispersion g(0); Phi from coupling K and the leading eigenvalue of the kappa-adjacency A_kappa; regime read from asymptotic <R> (subcritical <R> <= 1.5*3/sqrt(N) vs supercritical > 0.5).
terms.units: K, K_c, gamma in coupling units (inverse time); R_inf, Phi dimensionless
terms.validity_domain: Asymptotic (t->inf) laws; mean-field / Ott-Antonsen reductions require the stated frequency distributions. Cryptobiosis DORMANT and the maintenance-hierarchy 'phase transition into noise' are engineering state machines, NOT the same bifurcation.
alternatives: Finite-size rounding of the transition (no true singularity at finite N)
A smooth crossover mistaken for a sharp transition
Hysteresis arising from slow relaxation rather than genuine bistability
terms.falsifier: INV-K2/K3: R(t->inf) fails the sub/supercritical prediction across K_c. INV-KR1: sign(Phi) fails to predict the <R> regime. INV-ES1: measured hysteresis width < 0.

terms.name: criticality
terms.math_object: Adaptive-criticality isolation threshold kappa_critical = -ln(dH_max/epsilon)/(lambda_local + delta) with lambda_local the DFA Hurst exponent; DRO regime scaling gamma = 2*H + 1 (Peng et al. 1994).
terms.observable_mapping: H from DFA-1 on diff(log price); dH_max = rolling max of |dH| over the last 256 steps; a node with kappa(node) < kappa_critical is ISOLATED and a fragmentation event is logged. epsilon = 0.05 (SNR tolerance), delta = 1e-4 (singularity floor).
terms.units: H, kappa, kappa_critical dimensionless; gamma = 2H+1 dimensionless
terms.validity_domain: Operational fragility/regime gate ONLY. Does NOT assert market self-organized criticality. gamma = 2H+1 is the fractional-Gaussian scaling identity (INV-DRO1), tested to |gamma-(2H+1)| < 1e-5. Documented limitation: reactive on jump-diffusion boundaries.
alternatives: Estimator: DFA Hurst is biased under short windows / non-stationarity, moving kappa_critical spuriously
The gate is a control heuristic, not evidence of a physical critical point
The regime label reflects ADF/stationarity artifacts (INV-DRO3), not criticality
terms.falsifier: INV-DRO1: |gamma - (2H+1)| >= 1e-5. INV-AC1-rev: a node with kappa(node) < kappa_critical is NOT isolated. INV-DRO5: NaN/Inf/constant input fails to raise ValueError (silent repair).

terms.name: serotonin
terms.math_object: Bounded sigmoidal control state s(t) = sigmoid(k*(tonic - theta)) * sensitivity with a Lyapunov functional V(s) non-increasing at zero stress; s in [0,1], sensitivity in [0.1,1.0].
terms.observable_mapping: Input = a scalar stress/drawdown proxy (drawdown enters NEGATIVE); output = a risk-tempering scalar. This is an arithmetic control proxy; the label 'serotonin' is metaphorical -- no neurotransmitter, receptor, or biological pathway is modeled or measured.
terms.units: dimensionless control scalar in [0,1]; 'stress' in normalized proxy units
terms.validity_domain: Engineering risk-control analogue only. Per INV-HOM1 the E/I/'serotonin' quantities are arithmetic proxies (non-claim). NOT a neuroscience or pharmacology claim.
alternatives: The behavior is fully explained by a plain bounded sigmoid controller with no neuromodulatory content
Any monotone squashing function would give the same risk-tempering effect
terms.falsifier: INV-5HT2: s(t) leaves [0,1]. INV-5HT1: V(s) increases at zero stress. INV-5HT7: stress >= 1.0 or |dd| >= 0.5 fails to trigger the safety veto.
terms.note: ANALOGUE / non-claim. 'Serotonin' names an arithmetic risk-control proxy, not biological serotonin. Per INV-HOM1 the neuromodulator vocabulary is an engineering analogue; no biological mechanism is asserted or measured. The listed invariants govern the arithmetic (boundedness, descent, veto), NOT a neurophysiological claim.

terms.name: dopamine
terms.math_object: Temporal-difference error delta = r + gamma*V' - V (raw controller, d(delta)/dr = 1); execution-adapter variant |delta| = |tanh(.)| <= 1 (d(delta)/dr = sech^2(.) != 1 by design).
terms.observable_mapping: Input = a scalar reward/return-surprise proxy r; output = a TD error used to nudge a value estimate. 'Dopamine' is a metaphor for the RPE arithmetic; no dopaminergic biology is modeled or measured.
terms.units: delta dimensionless (same units as the reward proxy); gamma in (0,1] dimensionless
terms.validity_domain: Reinforcement-learning arithmetic analogue only. Scope split: INV-DA7 raw controller vs INV-DA8 tanh adapter. NOT a neuroscience claim.
alternatives: Identical to a textbook TD(0) update with no biological content
Any bounded reward-surprise signal reproduces the observed behavior
terms.falsifier: INV-DA7: d(delta)/dr != 1 for the raw controller. INV-DA3: gamma outside (0,1]. INV-DA8: adapter |delta| > 1 or non-finite for finite input.
terms.note: ANALOGUE / non-claim. 'Dopamine' names a TD-error arithmetic proxy, not biological dopamine. Per INV-HOM1 the neuromodulator vocabulary is an engineering analogue; no biological mechanism is asserted or measured.

terms.name: gaba
terms.math_object: Inhibition gate g in [0,1] with effective = raw*(1 - inhibition); inhibition is monotone increasing in volatility, -> 0 as vol -> 0, -> 1 as vol -> inf.
terms.observable_mapping: Input = a volatility proxy; output = a multiplicative inhibition factor that can only REDUCE an upstream signal (effective <= raw). 'GABA' is a metaphor for the clamp arithmetic; no chloride channel or receptor is modeled.
terms.units: dimensionless gate in [0,1]; volatility proxy in normalized units
terms.validity_domain: Engineering inhibition analogue only. NOT a neuroscience claim.
alternatives: Equivalent to a plain volatility-scaled down-weighting with no biological content
Any saturating monotone clamp reproduces the INV-GABA behavior
terms.falsifier: INV-GABA1: gate outside [0,1]. INV-GABA3: effective > raw (inhibition amplifies instead of reducing). INV-GABA4/5: wrong asymptote as vol -> 0 or vol -> inf.
terms.note: ANALOGUE / non-claim. 'GABA' names an inhibition-clamp arithmetic proxy, not biological GABA. Per INV-HOM1 the neuromodulator vocabulary is an engineering analogue; no biological mechanism is asserted or measured.

terms.name: heisenberg_uncertainty
terms.math_object: (RETIRED) The prior framing asserted a Heisenberg bound dx*dp >= hbar/2 on price and its difference -- a category error with a fabricated hbar/2. Superseded by the exact Gabor time-frequency limit dt*df >= 1/(4*pi) (INV-GABOR1).
terms.observable_mapping: None valid. Price and diff(price) are jointly observable, NOT conjugate, and there is no Planck constant. The retired term had no admissible observable->math mapping.
terms.validity_domain: RETIRED -- do not use as a mechanism. The live, operationally-defined object is the Gabor uncertainty limit 1/(4*pi) approx 0.0796 (dimensionless), not a Heisenberg inequality.
alternatives: The correct object is the Gabor/Fourier time-frequency uncertainty (INV-GABOR1), which needs no hbar
The apparent 'quantum uncertainty' was an artifact of treating jointly-observable series as conjugate
terms.falsifier: (Preserved as tombstone) INV-GABOR1: time_frequency_spread returning dt*df < 1/(4*pi) for a well-resolved signal would refute the REPLACEMENT object; the retired hbar/2 framing is unfalsifiable-as-stated and therefore withdrawn.
terms.note: RETIRED tombstone. The 'quantum/Heisenberg uncertainty' framing was a category error (fabricated hbar/2 on non-conjugate observables) and is withdrawn as negative evidence. Replaced by the Gabor time-frequency limit INV-GABOR1. Never backs a live claim.
